title: Maximal Arboreal Galois Images for Polynomials of Twisted Carlitz Type
summary: In this paper, we study the arboreal Galois representations for polynomials of twisted Carlitz type, whose first iterated Galois group is linked to the torsion of a twisted Carlitz module. We prove two explicit families of polynomials having iterated Galois groups isomorphic to full iterated cyclic wreath product at every level.
